description: This file defines React components for a UI sheet/modal, utilizing Radix UI primitives and custom styling utilities. It includes components like Sheet, SheetTrigger, SheetClose, SheetContent, and others, with styling and behavior for animated slide-in/out effects and overlay handling.

methods.name: Sheet
methods.description: Main component wrapping Radix UI Root for the sheet modal.

methods.name: SheetTrigger
methods.description: Component to trigger opening the sheet.

methods.name: SheetPortal
methods.description: Component rendering the sheet in a portal.

methods.name: SheetOverlay
methods.description: Overlay component with styling and animation.

methods.name: SheetContent
methods.description: Main content area of the sheet with slide-in/out animations based on side.
